controls.outcome: Selected mixed target takes an actual reachable unexcluded source donor and expected current unmix alpha; contaminated source seed is excluded only in its source-bound literal list.
Remove the exclusion and reproduce exact original contaminated donor/RGBA. Restore the exclusion and reproduce the corrected result. Reverse the observed outcome, not a code-path flag.
A source donor exclusion without a target does not recolour the excluded pixel. Nonempty exclusions require explicit targets; reject rather than run globally.
Omitted and [] exclusions retain exact synthetic default RGBA/algorithm receipt and historical Butterfly/Cricket hashes/receipts.

Exact opaque brown, cream, green, coral and magenta pigment outside targets retains every RGBA byte. Protected pigment cannot be selected or excluded as a donor; wrong-pigment selection/control mutations must reject.
Exclude every donor in a connected component: preserve target default RGBA, return exact unresolved target indices/status, block production. Restoring one valid donor resolves the target.

A closer-looking neutral donor across a real source key gap cannot be used. Gap stays alpha0; no fill/bridge/restored source island. Removing the gap in a synthetic control changes reachability, proving the instrument sees the actual geometry.
Wrong original SHA/RGBA/dimensions or altered canonical/seal rejects; restore exact inputs to pass.
Every changed channel lies in the explicit target set; no positive support/opacity increase versus default, no protected pigment change. Outside-selection/alpha-growth/pigment-damage mutants reject.
Ignoring the exclusion must fail the required material outcome; re-enabling it restores that outcome.

Record every changed canonical-positive channel, old/new donor index and actual raw donor RGB; preserve source/canonical/seal/approved19 controls and all protected anatomy, open gaps and topology. Actual gray/black full1254/plumes/underbody review decides CLEAN or HOLD; numbers alone cannot.
R02 cyan/self-donor failure and C475 opaque-brown material failure remain retained. A test never accepts merely because fewer pixels exceed a key-excess metric.

execution: Root reserved CPU/test queue only after concrete proposal review; no worker execution. Historical fixtures require exact retained outcomes.
